notes: NOT POPULATED: every just.edu.jo and services.just.edu.jo URL (pages and PDFs, Arabic and English) returned the site's WAF page 'Request Rejected – The requested URL was rejected' to the fetcher, and admhec.gov.jo is robots-disallowed, so no college or major could be verified from an official source. colleges is intentionally empty. Leads for a re-run from a normal browser: faculty programme pages follow https://www.just.edu.jo/ar/FacultiesandDepartments/<faculty>/Pages/Programs.aspx?degree=1 (e.g. /it/ for Computer & IT, /FacultyofMedicine/); current study plans exist e.g. .../it/Departments/cs/SiteAssets/Pages/Programs/CS-Arabic-Study Plan 2025-UPDATED-OCT_2025.pdf and AI-Arabic-StudyPlan-UPDATED-OCT 2025 (3).pdf; fee/program tables under https://services.just.edu.jo/applic/Documents/ (e.g. Fees_Regular_2024_En.pdf). Non-official (Wikipedia) lists 12 faculties: Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Applied Medical Sciences, Science and Arts, Engineering, Computer and Information Technology, Architecture and Design, Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, Graduate Studies – not used as data. email_domains: just.edu.jo is the university's official domain; whether students use the same domain or a subdomain for Microsoft 365 is NOT verified. Centre coordinates are the Wikipedia infobox point (32°28′44″N 35°59′6″E, Ar Ramtha), not verified on OSM. Portal/e-learning/library/calendar links not verified, so omitted. Brand colour not found.
